clips.text: Here are the questions people ask most. With nice short answers.
Does it cost anything? No. It's free.
Do I need Claude? Yes, you do. Claude writes the scenes. But the free plan works fine.
How long does it take? About as long as the reel itself. So, a minute or two.
Can it get things wrong? It can. For money, health or the law, always check with whoever sent you the original.
Can I keep it? Yes. Ask Claude for the video, and you get a file to save or send.
